decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX is a renamed version of the established BASIC 518 trommel, which has a proven following, so it likely still meets the aspiration even though it was not observed on the website in 2020–2021.

The flail shredder line had its own page and fits the core mobile portfolio, but its disappearance from view and likely tighter slack after the firm's financial strain raise the risk of consolidation.
This line had low visibility, overlaps with the green-waste grinder and is not observed after 2018, so problemistic search under limited slack favours folding it into a leaner grinder range.
The stationary electric fine shredder was only mentioned and has no evidence of results, so a firm short of slack would redirect its resources to its core mobile machines.
Green waste and composting are core segments, so this grinder line is the more likely survivor of any consolidation of the grinder range.
The single-shaft pre-shredders had their own page and anchor the stationary plant business, so the firm keeps them despite missing evidence of results.
